modos.descricao: Firearm: permite combat cards Rg3 ou menos em Homid form

params.descricao: Firearm - Homid only - Rg3 ou menos

_metadata.texto_original: Weapon. Firearm. Only usable by creatures in Homid form. This Firearm allows this creature to play combat cards of Rage 3 or less. .38 Special does not count as a Weapon for purposes of determining how many weapons a creature may have equipped.
